ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, parallelogram $ABCD$ has diagonals $AC$ and $BD$ intersecting at point $O$. Point $F$ is the midpoint of $BC$, and connecting $DF$ intersects $AC$ at point $E$. What is the ratio of $DE:EF$?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} As shown in the figure, connect OF, \\
$\because$ Quadrilateral ABCD is a parallelogram,\\
$\therefore$ O is the midpoint of BD,\\
$\because$ F is the midpoint of BC,\\
$\therefore$ OF is the median of $\triangle$BCD,\\
$\therefore$ CD $=$ 2OF, and OF $\parallel$ CD,\\
$\therefore$ $\triangle$DEC $\sim$ $\triangle$FEO,\\
$\therefore$ DE$\colon$EF $=$ CD$\colon$OF $=$ \boxed{2\colon1}.

method.method_draft: Use affine/vector coordinates. From the image and text, model ABCD as a parallelogram with B as the origin, C = 2u, A = v, and D = 2u + v; this coordinate choice preserves ratios on straight lines. Since F is the midpoint of BC, F = u. The line AC is v + t(2u - v). The line DF is D + s(F - D) = 2u + v + s(-u - v), where s measures the fraction from D toward F. At the intersection E, solve v + t(2u - v) = 2u + v + s(-u - v). Comparing coefficients of u and v gives 2t = 2 - s and 1 - t = 1 - s, so t = s and 2s = 2 - s, hence s = 2/3. Therefore E is two-thirds of the way from D to F, so DE:EF = (2/3):(1/3) = 2:1.

先描述图像：图中四边形ABCD为平行四边形，A、B在左侧，D、C在右侧；对角线AC和BD相交于O；点F在BC上，且题意说明F为BC的中点；连接DF后，它与AC相交于E。

再推理：按指定方法使用仿射/向量坐标。设B为原点，令C=2u，A=v。因为ABCD是平行四边形，所以D=A+C-B=2u+v。由于F是BC的中点，所以F=u。

直线AC上的点可写为v+t(2u-v)，即系数形式为2t·u+(1-t)·v。直线DF上的点从D向F参数化为D+s(F-D)=2u+v+s(u-2u-v)=2u+v+s(-u-v)，即(2-s)·u+(1-s)·v。

交点E同时在AC与DF上，所以比较u、v的系数：2t=2-s，且1-t=1-s。由第二式得t=s，代入第一式得2s=2-s，所以3s=2，s=2/3。这里s表示E从D到F所走的比例，因此DE占DF的2/3，EF占DF的1/3，所以DE:EF=(2/3):(1/3)=2:1。

Point F is marked on BC, segment DF intersects diagonal AC at E, and from the figure it can be seen that C, E, O, A are on the same straight line AC, therefore E is also on segment CO inside triangle BCD.

Reasoning: Because ABCD is a parallelogram, the diagonals bisect each other, so O is the midpoint of BD. In triangle BCD, CO is the median from vertex C to midpoint O of side BD. Also because F is the midpoint of BC, DF is the median from vertex D to midpoint F of side BC. The intersection point of the two medians CO and DF is E, therefore E is the centroid of triangle BCD. The centroid divides each median in a 2:1 ratio in the direction from the vertex to the opposite side, so on median DF there is DE:EF = 2:1.
